name: compare_artifacts
description: Compare complete artifact inventories by logical occurrence path, content identity, metadata, and graph relations. Pass the inventory Evidence nested in each inspect_artifact result as left and right, or pass its inspect_analysis_view summary while the complete parent Evidence remains retained in this session. Summary facts are not treated as a complete inventory; comparison resolves the exact retained parent. Every delta cites both complete inputs, and gaps yield truncated or unknown, never equivalence. Returns every change inline.

parameters.description: Advertised in reduced form by the compact input schema profile; the server still validates complete canonical inputs.

left.description: Left-hand input used for comparison or differential execution.

right.description: Right-hand input used for comparison or differential execution.
